 Lukas Van Ness, Javon Bullard also active after being questionable
 Nov 15, 2026 at 10:30 AM Mike Spofford packers.com editor
 Copied! 
 Emma Pravecek, packers.com S Xavier McKinney GREEN BAY -- Packers S Xavier McKinney , edge rusher Lukas Van Ness and S Javon Bullard are all active for Sunday's home game vs. the Vikings after being questionable on the injury report.
 Here's the full list of inactives:
 Green Bay Packers 
 8 RB Josh Jacobs 
 22 RB Pierre Strong Jr. 
 44 LB Zaire Franklin 
 67 G/T Donovan Jennings 
 70 G Kevin Zeitler 
 75 C Sean Rhyan 
 Minnesota Vikings 
 1 QB Kyler Murray
 3 WR Jordan Addison
 12 QB Max Brosmer (3rd QB)
 14 WR Jauan Jennings
 51 LB Blake Cashman
 87 TE T.J. Hockenson
 90 DL Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins
